title: Rock Bottom Is a Foundation
description: Everyone talks about hitting rock bottom like it's the end. What if it's actually the first solid thing you've stood on in years?
showNotes:
Rock bottom gets romanticized or demonized. The truth is somewhere in the middle. In this episode I talk about what my version of it looked like and why it was actually the first honest ground I'd stood on in a long time.

**Key Topics:**
- What rock bottom actually looks like (it's not always dramatic)
- The relief of having nothing left to pretend about
- Using the foundation to build something real
- Why the climb up is slower and harder than you expect
